title: Antibiotic resistance at environmental multi-media interfaces through integrated genotype and phenotype analysis.
abstract: Antibiotic resistance is currently an unfolding global crisis threatening human health worldwide. While antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) are known to be pervasive in environmental media, the occurrence of antibiotic resistance at interfaces between two or more adjacent media is largely unknown.
